verdict.rationale: SerpApi publishes per-engine API reference pages with documented parameters (output format, topic tokens, location, async mode), served as markdown for agents. Its GitHub README mentions a 'script builder' for getting started and includes copy-paste code examples. However, nothing shows an interactive in-browser playground where examples can be run live, and the OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented interactive playground with runnable requests, evidence of how the script builder works, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.
